title: Sailing boat ride at sunset
text:
Sunset sailing tour in Barcelona – unforgettable experience
We made a sunset departure from the Olympic Port and it was spectacular. The sailing tour offers unique views of the Barcelona skyline, with Cava, Music and a Relaxed Mood. Ideal for couples or groups looking for a different boat experience. Highly recommended!

title: Five star sailing experience. Would do again in a heartbeat!
text: Best sunset cruise ever! Lluis and his wife ensured that we had everything we needed and were very accommodating. They made sure we had plenty of cava, snacks, took lots of sunset pics, and let us control the Bluetooth speaker. The water was relatively calm and we had the option to go further out in the sea or stay near the harbor. We opted to stay near the harbor and enjoyed looking at the skyline and the other boats. It was easy to find the starting point of the tour and Lluis messaged me on WhatsApp the day of so I was able to ask any questions I had. Would recommend this to anyone travelin

title: Five stars all around
text: Wonderful sunset cruise experience with my husband! I really enjoyed that we could control the music and Lluis and his wife were very accommodating. We were able to choose between sailing out in the ocean or staying close to the harbor. We opted to stay close to the harbor and enjoyed looking at all the yachts. Very easy to find based on the directions, and Lluis messaged me on What’s App beforehand which was also very helpful.
